name: NeRF-Det
definition: A method for indoor 3D object detection using posed RGB images that explicitly models scene geometry as an opacity field by jointly training a NeRF branch with a 3D detection pipeline.
summary: NeRF-Det is an indoor 3D object detection method that jointly trains a NeRF and detector via a shared geometry MLP, ensuring gradient flow and multi-view consistency to outperform decoupled approaches.
